description: DbUser is the Schema for the dbusers API

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: User and access settings for the referenced Database.

accessType.description: Access level to grant. Supported values are readOnly and readWrite.

cleanup.description:
Adds this DbUser as an owner of the Kubernetes resources it creates.
Kubernetes garbage collection then removes those resources with the DbUser.

credentials.description: Generated credential data and Secret metadata.

metadata.description: Labels and annotations on the generated credential Secret.

extraAnnotations.description:
Annotations to merge into the generated credential Secret.
Values in this map replace existing values for the same keys.

extraLabels.description:
Labels to merge into the generated credential Secret.
Values in this map replace existing values for the same keys.

templates.description: Additional data entries for generated Secrets and ConfigMaps.

name.description: Data key written to the generated Secret or ConfigMap.

secret.description:
Writes the entry to a Secret when true and to a ConfigMap when false.
DbUser templates must set this field to true.

template.description: Go template evaluated with database connection values and template helper functions.

databaseRef.description:
Name of the Database that the user can access.
The Database must be in the same namespace as the DbUser.

existingUser.description:
Name of an existing database user to manage instead of creating a user.
The operator grants and revokes permissions for this user but does not create or delete it.

extraPrivileges.description:
Additional database roles to grant to the user.
Every role must also appear in the referenced DbInstance's allowedPrivileges list.
ALL PRIVILEGES is not allowed. This feature is experimental.

grantToAdmin.description:
Grants the new user to the PostgreSQL administrator role.
This is commonly required when the managed administrator is not a superuser,
such as on Azure Database for PostgreSQL. It may need to be false when using
roles such as rds_iam on Amazon RDS. It has no effect on MySQL.

secretName.description: Name of the Secret that stores the generated user credentials.

status.description: Observed state of the database user.

created.description: True after the operator has created the user or begun managing an existing user.
